items.title: Roswell Rudd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: You know I’m playing basketball with Michael Jordan.

ctx.x: You must hold yourself to a pretty high standard I think if you feel in ‘97 you are finally happy with or pleased—

Yeah, I finally said I made a statement, because in the past I’ve always said well I had my moments. But now here is a moment. Here is a seven minute moment, not a three second moment or a split second moment or a good chorus of something. But I finally made a seven minute statement, building. And I have to hold myself up to the great architects of my tradition like Herbie Nichols and Monk and Archie Shepp and so forth, and I have to say well I think this is the closest I’ve gotten so far. So I have to have high…
You’ve got a tradition to live up to. © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-
